class.name: AnimationWorkbenchEditorPlugin
class.brief_description: Built-in editor for skeletal animation assets and clip editing.
class.description: Provides the central skeleton and animation workspace, independent model preview, timeline, clip drafts and GLB asset import. Preview model selection is limited to project [code].skmesh[/code] assets whose [AnimationPlayer] uses the current skeleton. The editor creates this plugin automatically for every project.

method.name: create_animation_library
method.description: Creates the folder for a new, empty animation library in the open skeleton's animation directory.

method.name: delete_animation
method.description: Moves the clip file of the named animation of the open skeleton to the system trash.

method.name: delete_clip_range
method.description: Returns a copy of [param animation] without the time range from [param first] (inclusive) to [param last] (exclusive), as a [Dictionary] with [code]error[/code], [code]message[/code], [code]animation[/code] and [code]removed_markers[/code]. Keys of every track and markers after the range move earlier; markers inside it are removed. Does not need an open document.

method.name: delete_range
method.description: Deletes the half-open interval in seconds from the current draft. Supports uncompressed 3D transform and blend shape tracks. Save separately to write the result to disk.

method.name: get_current_animation
method.description: Returns the current in-memory clip result.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the reason of the most recent failed edit or save, or an empty string.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the current document, clip, playback time, selection, preview speed and loop state, clip loop mode, modified flags and undo depth as a [Dictionary]. Intended for scripted checks.

method.name: import_files
method.description: Imports every external GLB in [param sources] into [param destination] with the same [param settings] (see [method EditorInterface.import_animation_assets]). Returns a [Dictionary] with [code]error[/code], a per-file [code]message[/code], [code]results[/code] and the first created [code]model[/code], [code]clip[/code] or [code]scene[/code].

method.name: is_preview_loop_enabled
method.description: Returns whether the preview transport loops at the end of the current clip. This is independent from the clip's stored loop mode.

method.name: migrate_legacy_animations
method.description: Moves the clips a skeleton file still lists itself into its animation directory, naming each file after its animation, and saves the skeleton without the list. Animation names stay the same.

method.name: move_animation
method.description: Moves the clip file of the named animation of the open skeleton into the library folder [param library]. An empty name is the default library. The animation is then addressed as [code]library/animation[/code].

method.name: open_player
method.description: Opens a central document for this player's actual libraries and previews a copy of its 3D animation root.

method.name: open_resource
method.description: Opens a SkeletonDefinition or Animation asset in a central document.

method.name: rebind_animation
method.description: Binds a [code].skanim[/code] clip to [param skeleton] and moves its file into that skeleton's animation directory as [param animation_name], which may be [code]library/animation[/code]. Fails if the clip uses bones the skeleton does not have or the name is taken.

method.name: redo_edit
method.description: Redoes one clip edit.

method.name: rename_animation
method.description: Renames the clip file of the named animation of the open skeleton, which renames the animation. Scripts and animation graphs that use the old name are not updated.

method.name: rename_animation_library
method.description: Renames a library folder of the open skeleton, which renames every animation in it.

method.name: save_animation
method.description: Saves the current clip while retaining existing resource references.

method.name: seek
method.description: Pauses the preview and samples the current clip at [param time] seconds.

method.name: select_animation
method.description: Selects an animation by its full player animation name.

method.name: set_animation_directory
method.description: Points the open skeleton at another existing project folder as its animation directory and saves the skeleton. A folder below the skeleton file is stored relative to it. Clip files are not moved.

method.name: set_loop_mode
method.description: Changes the loop mode of the current clip draft. The change follows undo and is written by [method save_animation].

method.name: set_playing
method.description: Starts or pauses the preview.

method.name: set_preview_loop
method.description: Sets the workbench-wide preview loop. Switching clips keeps this state and does not change the clip's stored loop mode.

method.name: set_preview_speed
method.description: Sets the workbench-wide preview speed to the closest available preset. Switching clips keeps this state.

method.name: set_selection
method.description: Sets the timeline selection in seconds.

method.name: undo_edit
method.description: Undoes one clip edit. Saving after undo writes that result to disk.
